notes.observation: Stored source footnote and retained Adab723 Arabic explicitly report Ibn al-Zubayr's thunder practice. Independent Companion attribution is supported.

Stored retained Bukhari2049 Arabic has the blessing inside a continuous Anas narrative including the Prophet establishing brotherhood and later dialogue. Whole-record hadith/context association can retain the actual Companion speaker; no claim the Prophet said or specifically approved the blessing.

Stored retained Nasai10243 Arabic connects Aisha's reply to the Prophet's instruction to distribute a sheep. Context association can preserve this event link, but the printed singular formula remains an adaptation of the plural witness and is not certified as exact Prophetic matn.

policy_distinction: A coherent event involving Prophetic action/dialogue can be grouped as hadith context while preserving non-Prophetic speakers and adaptations. A separately appended habitual Companion prayer or custom with no evidenced event-specific Prophetic participation/approval can remain independent selected-content material. Counts of these context associations are not counts of verified Prophetic matns.
scope_limit: No new live source retrieval, no new canonical IDs/grades/isnads, no independent evaluation of assembled changed bytes.
